File No. 9419
Experiment Subject: Racer "Dymond"

Experiment Date: ████
The project has finally been set in motion. Everything is moving at full steam ahead.

The hardest part has been resolved with surprising ease. We found a suitable test subject. That racer who defied Yabuli can now experience firsthand the wonders and mysteries of biological science.
...

Experiment Date: ████
The experiment is progressing smoothly. Ms. Yabuli's project advances steadily.

Based on the fruits of our long-term research, we have successfully performed an "Organic Life Imagenesis Project" modification on the target subject. Not only is he capable of performing normal activities such as walking and thinking, he also operates with precision that far exceeds that of an ordinary race car.
...

Experiment Date: ████
Recent experiments have been unsatisfactory. The test subject has repeatedly displayed tendencies toward escape and resistance.

In theory, augmented subjects cannot leave Astropolis. Even so, to prevent classified experimental data from leaking, Ms. Yabuli had an irreversible "failsafe" implanted in the test subject. Should the test subject attempt to leave the Life Sciences Institute, his limbs would grow weak, and he would eventually find himself at death's door.

Excellent. With that safeguard in place, we can disregard the test subject's emotional state and proceed with more aggressive experimental methods.
...

Recorded by:
Assistant Researcher "Kash"
